speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The Monday copper has cooled, Master Shakespeare, and the horn is filled if you want it. Twopence, when you take it upstairs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take it, Mistress. The twopence is on the dresser.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If you had played you would have shouted, and instead you read. I see little thrift in either.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The street was quiet. The watch at the gate looked at the carts, and that was the whole of the afternoon.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I stayed at the back. Nobody knocked.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If anybody asks, Gillis is from Norwich. He has always had a Norwich face. I do not change a story because the sun is out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the story holds, Mistress. I will not improve it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will not improve it either. The loom stayed in the back room.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit, if you are boarding. Threepence the meal. Cold mutton, and the broth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. Threepence, and I am not arguing the price.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf wants a full thumb of the notch. Mark me, by Michaelmas we'll be eating the board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It was short at noon as well, Mistress. Cutting it does not put the thumb back.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Cutting never did. A penny loaf is a penny. Sit up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have sat. You will want the morning, Mistress. You always ask when the knife is out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Was it a wedding or a trouble?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A king, Mistress. He talks. The room heard him through. We are not playing him this week.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then he can talk in Holywell, and not at my board. Eat while the broth has some honesty left in it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In a play the houses are still standing when the talking stops. That is a kind of mercy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: They stay standing if the bolts are in. Alse, the small beer.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Here, sir. Gib is on the Golding again. I did not shift him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. Dick has the forty leaves. I am not opening a book tonight.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: You will not write, then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not a line. The horn is filled. Tomorrow can have it, if tomorrow wants ink.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I will not come up for a light. You had the one last night, and the front stayed black.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stayed black. The king is done for today. That is as much as I mean to say of him at a table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I cut for Gillis, Mistress?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Cut, and mind the notch. Master Shakespeare has paid. That is the whole of Monday.
